# PowerPlay v1.3.0 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Introduced PowerLink: Home Assistant-initiated room-to-room playback handoff with authenticated, short-lived transfer links.
- Preserved ordered Plex queues (including shuffle, repeated episodes, the current item, and playback position) during transfer.
- Added per-device HD/4K media matching and Home Assistant-managed device wake routines with bounded queue windows.

## Compatibility

PowerLink transfers require the companion [PowerLink HACS integration](https://github.com/The-Power-0/PowerLink), configured separately in Home Assistant.
